subject: Quote for bathroom renovation
body: Hello, we would like a quote to renovate a 6 m2 bathroom: remove the bathtub, install a walk-in shower, new tiles and a new sink. The flat is on the second floor with a lift. Could someone visit next week? Thanks, Laura

subject: URGENT water leak from the ceiling
body: Since this morning water is dripping from the kitchen ceiling right where your team replaced the pipes last month. It is getting worse and we have put buckets down. Please send someone today.

subject: Still waiting for the final invoice

subject: Quote for full flat renovation, budget question
body: We just bought a 90 m2 flat built in 1975 and want to renovate everything: electrics, plumbing, kitchen, two bathrooms and floors. Roughly what budget should we expect, and how long would it take?

subject: Noise and dust in the stairwell
body: Your workers start drilling at 7:30 and the stairwell is full of dust every day. The building rules say no noise before 9. If this continues I will complain to the building manager.
